text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And another great showing from Mihono

Bourbon!
Wooooo!

After finishing the race, Mihono Bourbon
stands
stock-still among the thunderous
cheers pouring
from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Faint tightening in chest area detected.
Initiating
scan.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Currently experiencing elevated mood
and
shortness of breath—features that
are common to
"restlessness" and
"excitement."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analysis complete. Maximum levels of

"exhilaration" have been identified.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You may not have won, but that was a
stunning
race, Bourbon!

Fans start shouting words of
encouragement one
after another.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Great job, Teio! Great job, Bourbon!
That was the
best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: You've come so far, Bourbon! Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Tears have been detected in fans' eyes.
This
indicates they are experiencing a
similar state of
"exhilaration."

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
You were so inspiring out there,
Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see. So this is what it feels like to
"inspire"
others.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I feel... "happy" right now, Trainer.

After Mihono Bourbon changes into
clean
clothes, we get ready to leave the
Tokyo
Racecourse when someone calls
out to us.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the great race, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, I should thank you. You helped me
obtain
extremely rare knowledge and
experience from
our race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haha! You're too kind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
While Tokai Teio laughs cheerfully,
Mihono
Bourbon studies her face
intently.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But you won. Why do you feel
"frustrated" and
not "happy"?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why? 'Cause I could literally feel just
how
amazing you are!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This kinda thing isn't just about winning
or losing!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But... it was so fun that I could get over
my
frustration! Really! It was even more
fun than I
expected!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So...

Tokai Teio's eyes sparkle as she looks
fearlessly
at Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Let's have a rematch someday!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's the response I was lookin' for. See
ya, then!

Mihono Bourbon gives a small, friendly
wave in
response as Tokai Teio runs off.
